Offers more hearts than the raw version.|Inventory|TotK}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Roasted Bass are a type of [[Roasted Food]], resulting from [[Hyrule Bass]] or [[Staminoka Bass]] that have made contact with [[Fire]] or a [[Scorching Climate]].{{Cite Guide|BotW Piggyback|page= 295}} [[Blue Hinox]]es also have the potential to drop them after death, and they are sold at the [[Protein Palace]] [[General Store]] in [[Goron City]]. Roasted Bass is said to have flaky flesh and smell savory. [[Link]] can restore one and a half [[Heart]]s to his [[Life Gauge]] by eating a Roasted Bass. ==={{TotK|-}}=== Roasted Bass reappear in {{TotK}} and are again a variety of [[Roasted Food]]. They can be made by exposing [[Hyrule Bass]] or [[Staminoka Bass]] to [[Fire]] or a [[Scorching Climate]]. Roasted Bass is said to have flaky flesh and smell savory. [[Link]] can restore one and a half [[Heart]]s to his [[Life Gauge]] by eating a Roasted Bass. ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Bass * Food * Frozen Bass * Roasted Food * Roasted Hearty Bass }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Food, Health Restoring Items, Roasted Food, Seafood |items= BotW, TotK }}
